title: Having `free()` in an GDScript function causes the entire Node to be broken in release builds
body:
### Tested versions

-Reproducible in v4.6.stable.official [89cea1439] and v4.0.stable.official [92bee43ad]

### System information

Godot v4.6.stable - Linux Mint 22.3 (Zena) on X11 - X11 display driver, Multi-window, 2 monitors - OpenGL 3 (Compatibility) - NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4070 Laptop GPU - 13th Gen Intel(R) Core(TM) i9-13980HX (24 threads) - 30.96 GiB memory

### Issue description

When having the `free()` function in a GDScript, the entire Node stops working in Release builds. This manifests in any functions like `_process()` not to be executed or functions that would simply return Int values return `<null>`. The GDScript function containing `free()` doesn't even need to be executed, it's apparently enough for it to be written in some function, even if that function never gets called or used from anywhere. 

I've tested this issue mainly on Linux, but before I made a reproduction case, it was also observable in Windows and Web builds.

### Steps to reproduce

Working in editor and debug builds: 
1. Open and play the project in Editor
2. Click on the "CreateNewInstance" Button
3. Observe the console output to be `42`

Failing release build:
1. Make and run a release build with `--verbose` in the CLI to observe the console.
2. Click on the "CreateNewInstance" Button
3. Observe the console output to be `<null>`

If you comment foo_instance.gs:7 aka `free()` out, `42` is returned and printed in release builds as expected.

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

[godot-function-bug.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/25078514/godot-function-bug.zip)
